mk-01: Dhyana of Dakshina Kali — fierce face, unbound hair, four arms, garland of heads; reverent, not sensational.
mk-02: Jayanti, Mangala, Kali, Bhadrakali, Kapalini, Durga, Kshama, Shiva, Dhatri, Svaha, Svadha — homage to You.
mk-03: Kali, Mahakali, Kalika, supreme Lady of all goddesses — homage, ferry across the ocean of naraka.
